name: Insects
description: The insect prey base of the steppe as one bundled node - the source pooled all insects into a single 'Insecta' node because diet studies rarely resolved them further. Guild whose own diet the source could not resolve; it was placed at the producer level by the source's basal rule (any node without recorded prey counts as basal) and is re-leveled here as a primary consumer. Eaten by armadillos, skunks, foxes, mink and most birds of prey.
